Name: Soften Descent
Casting Time: 1 reaction, which you take when you are about to hit a surface after falling
Description: With a gesture, you cause an updraft in the air, slowing your descent. You ignore the first 30 feet when calculating falling damage.
At Higher Levels: This spell ignores an additional 30 feet of falling damage when you reach 5th level (60 feet), 11th level (90 feet), and 17th level (120 feet).
Sourcebook: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms
